The area was once considered sacred to the [[Deldrimor]], but has since been claimed by the [[Stone Summit]] and stripped for metal, turned into mines - the most notable of them being [[Sorrow's Furnace]] at the very base of the canyons. A few Deldrimor soldiers can be found in the more remote areas, scouting the terrain and searching for their lost brethren. ==Quests available== * [[Dwarven Prospector]] ** [[To Sorrow's Furnace]] **
